# Edson Boldrini

> Software engineer. I build products end to end — and I run one.
> Vitória, Brazil · Currently at Superset · Creator of CorteFilme

Edson Boldrini is a full-stack software engineer working across web and mobile —
TypeScript first, then Node, Vue, React, Flutter, Go and Elixir. He is based in
Vitória, Brazil, and works at Superset, the software platform personal trainers
and fitness coaches use to run their coaching business.

## What he builds

- **CorteFilme** — his own product: a web app that helps Brazilian window-film
  installers waste less film per roll. Landing in Next.js; product is a Vue/Quasar
  SPA on Hasura and PostgreSQL, with Node.js services, running in Docker on a VPS
  he operates. Case study: https://edsonboldrini.com.br/work/cortefilme
- **Superset** (current employer) — fitness coaching software: clients, programming
  and payments. He is a Software Engineer there.
- **Club Trip (Além)** — subscription travel product he built most of (Vue, Node,
  AdonisJS, Hasura, PostgreSQL).
- **Le Card** — mobile payments app built from scratch, paired with a Bluetooth
  card terminal (Xamarin, .NET Core).
- Past work: w3.care (health-care software), Conceptho (news apps), Dersalis
  (health and productivity smartband apps) — all as Full Stack Engineer.

## Open source

Small, honest experiments — integrations, not maintained libraries:

- flutter_getnet_pos — Flutter plugin for Getnet POS terminals (Java, Flutter)
- flutter_ycbtsdk — Objective-C wrapper around the YCB smartband SDK
